definitions.ask: Should colour, calendar, and default changes reroute unedited rows too, not just @route tokens?
definitions.why: Mirrors how time and title already follow Google while unedited

choices.label: Any non-series-memory source reroutes unedited rows, including token removal
Only a changed @route token reroutes; other sources affect new rows only

definitions.ask: Should rerouting also apply to done or already-worked rows?
definitions.why: Spans already update regardless of checkbox; a late token should fix attribution

choices.label: Any row whose [root::] you did not edit is rerouted, fixing a finished meeting too
Only open, unworked rows reroute; logged meetings keep their attribution

definitions.ask: Add a decisions record that [root::] follows Google until edited, superseding the old clause in part?
definitions.corrects: the vault owns the checkbox, `[root::]`, children, and the row itself
